title: "Localmap JC workflow report"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false

# Overview

This report demonstrates the end-to-end JC workflow: AOI + maps, raster/vector
attribute extraction, and provenance/attribution outputs. Render after running
the JC pipeline (see `docs/workflow.md`).

```{r}
#| label: summary
summary_tbl <- targets::tar_read(manifest_summary)
summary_tbl
```

# Maps

## Overview map

```{r}
#| label: overview-map
knitr::include_graphics("outputs/maps/jc_overview_map.png")
```

## Panel figure

```{r}
#| label: panel-figure
```

# Site attributes (preview)

```{r}
#| label: attributes-preview
attrs_long <- arrow::read_parquet("outputs/tables/jc_site_attributes_long.parquet")
attrs_wide <- readr::read_csv(
  "outputs/tables/jc_site_attributes_wide.csv",
  show_col_types = FALSE,
  num_threads = 1
)

head(attrs_long, 10)
```

```{r}
#| label: attributes-wide-preview
head(attrs_wide, 5)
```
